label: sec:categorical-mass-foundations-intro
html: This section turns to the algebraic backbone of the real trace functional over \mathbb{Z}[q, q^{-1}]. Under the descent involution \hat{\tau}, the categorical mass endomorphism splits into a descended observable eigenspace and a transient correction. This section establishes the categorical eigenspace decomposition, connects the Hecke trace to the Knizhnik–Zamolodchikov connection and Gibbs free energy, and formulates the Gröbner–Shirshov normal-form expansion and Littlewood–Richardson branching rules across multi-nucleon tensor products.
